proof_summary: The formalization reverses the Legendre symbol, using \((7/p)\) rather than \((p/7)\), and quadratic reciprocity makes these differ at \(p=11\). Direct computation gives the weighted sum as \(44\pmod{121}\), whereas \((7/11)=-1\) makes the asserted right-hand side \(-55\equiv66\pmod{121}\), yielding a contradiction.
